server.description: Search public DAT SDK and WebApps documentation and inspect authenticated Wearables Developer Center projects and releases.

protocolMetadata.instructions:
Meta Wearables developer platform: documentation search, plus read-only access to a developer's own Wearables Developer Center projects.

Pick the corpus that matches the question. `search_dat_docs` covers the Device Access Toolkit, the native iOS and Android SDK a third-party app uses to reach glasses hardware. `search_webapps_docs` covers web apps that run on the glasses. Search both when either could apply.

Both corpora are versioned and change between SDK releases, so search before answering rather than relying on recalled APIs, and quote the returned sections for version-specific details.

The `wdc_` tools read the caller's own projects, versions, builds and submissions. They require a Wearables Developer Center MCP token; without one, only documentation search is available.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Meta Wearables Developer Platform to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Meta Wearables Developer Platform to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.developer.meta.com/wearables.

_published_faq.name: Is Meta Wearables Developer Platform MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 16, 2026, Meta Wearables Developer Platform scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Meta Wearables Developer Platform's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 16, 2026, Meta Wearables Developer Platform scores 92/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 2 of 2 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Meta Wearables Developer Platform?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Meta Wearables Developer Platform in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
